cash_tip: Need pesos today? Norange and JAHGYRO Gyros take cards, so you can save your cash for other places, and when you do hit an ATM use a bank one and choose 'decline conversion' so you're charged in pesos. Take out one bigger amount instead of several small ones, and keep small bills handy for tacos, taxis and the market.
